svg.title: Grounded multi-pass lesson authoring data flow
svg.desc: Six steps. Gemini screens the clip, the 3D pipeline measures it, Gemini looks closely at player crops, teaches with measured placeholders, and verifies claims; deterministic checks finish the lesson.

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 1 Screen, Gemini: whole clip at 5 fps

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 2 Reconstruct and measure, GPU: cuts, SAM 3 tracking with ball, SAM 3D Body, analysis.analyze

div.style: color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: analysis.json: touches, plants, turn, drop, ball; tracking.json boxes

div.style: color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 3 Look, Gemini, per move: player-cropped close-up, half speed, 10 fps, measured events as fallible hints

div.style: color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 4 Teach, Gemini: checked timeline and lesson schema

div.style: color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 5 Verify, Gemini, per move: each claim against its close-up

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: 6 Deterministic checks: shots from analysis, keys snapped, challenges topped up, validate strict

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;

span.p: build_app: placeholders resolved from measurements, app_contract.check_bundle

div.style: color: rgb(21, 43, 70) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 120px; text-align: center; width: 120px;
